entries.title: Gas prices keep rising, but do big oil companies plan to drill more? Not so far
entries.snippet: The war in Iran has pushed global oil prices higher, which boosts oil company revenues. But major U.S. oil companies aren't signaling plans to increase production to bring down prices at the pump.

entries.title: Making a podcast helped one family talk about aging, dementia and death
entries.snippet: This year's winner in NPR's College Podcast Challenge is a letter to a grandparent that grapples with health issues including dementia. It's the story of a family learning to talk about hard things.

entries.title: Dirty nickel: The cost of mining in Indonesia
entries.snippet: Across six locations in Indonesia, NPR spoke with locals about how nickel mining is changing the land and daily life. It's brought jobs, but also concerns about environmental damage and public health.

entries.snippet: The vast majority of Americans — 8 in 10 — say there should be age caps for members of Congress, as well as term limits, according to the latest NPR/PBS News/Marist poll.

entries.title: Justice Department can keep 2020 ballots seized from Fulton County in Georgia, judge rules
entries.snippet: The Jan. 28 seizure by the FBI targeted the elections hub in Georgia's most populous county, which is heavily Democratic and includes most of the city of Atlanta.

entries.title: Some iPhone owners could get up to $95 after Apple agrees to settle case for $250 million
entries.snippet: Owners of some iPhones are in line to get cash payments of up to $95 from Apple after the company on Tuesday reached a $250 million settlement in a class-action lawsuit for false advertising of its artificial intelligence capabilities.

entries.snippet: Ted Turner, the founder of CNN, died on Wednesday at the age of 87. A risk-taking entrepreneur known for his outspoken style, Turner revolutionized how billions across the world consumed the news and created the first 24-hour news network. Judy Woodruff has this remembrance.

entries.snippet: President Donald Trump summoned reporters to the Oval Office on Wednesday touting the upcoming Ultimate Fighting Championship match that will take place at the White House in June.

entries.snippet: Rep. James Comer told reporters as he entered the closed-door interview that Lutnick had in the past not been "100% truthful" about whether he had ever visited Epstein's infamous private island.

entries.title: AP report: FBI searches Virginia Senate leader's office as part of corruption probe
entries.snippet: The search at Virginia Sen. L. Louise Lucas's district office in Portsmouth comes after the Democrat helped lead the state's recent redistricting effort.

entries.snippet: Seven candidates who want to be California's next governor traded sharp attacks Tuesday in a wide-ranging debate that touched on issues from gas prices to raising taxes to healthcare in a contest that has no clear leader.

entries.title: Pope will inaugurate Barcelona's Sagrada Familia tower and meet with migrants in June trip to Spain
entries.snippet: Pope Leo XIV will inaugurate the soaring central tower of Barcelona's famed Sagrada Familia basilica when he visits Spain next month in a weeklong trip that will also take him to a migrant reception center in the Canary Islands, the Vatican said Wednesday.

entries.snippet: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

entries.title: Eurovision 2026: Politics collide with a blockbuster show
entries.snippet: Controversy over Israel's participation and boycotts unprecedented in scale are already weighing on the Eurovision Song Contest before it even kicks off in Vienna.

entries.title: Hantavirus: Cruise company says no symptomatic guests on ship
entries.snippet: The company that operates the cruise ship struck by the hantavirus said that no passengers showing symptoms have remained on board. It also said 30 guests had disembarked on Saint Helena on April 24. DW has more.

entries.title: Solar sabotage: Why Europe sees security risks in solar power
entries.snippet: Europe's reliance on Chinese-made solar technology has triggered cybersecurity warnings over possible remote access to power grids. With EU funding curbs, the debate over the bloc's green energy strategy is heating up.

entries.title: Germany news: Coalition at odds over pay rises for MPs
entries.snippet: German conservatives want to hold on to automatic pay increases for lawmakers, while the center-left thinks they should skip it this year in light of the economic situation. DW has more.

entries.title: EU reaches tentative deal on simpler AI rules, plans ban on 'nudifier' apps
entries.snippet: In a provisional deal, the European Union has agreed on a ban on the use of AI for creating pornographic deepfakes and sexualized imagery. It has also agreed on amending certain rules within the EU's AI Act.

entries.title: 'Dark patterns': Investigating online manipulation
entries.snippet: Ireland's media regulator is investigating Facebook and Instagram on suspicion that so-called dark patterns are used to manipulate users.

entries.title: UK votes in key local and regional elections
entries.snippet: Prime Minister Keir Starmer's Labour Party is expected to face major losses, perhaps spelling the end of his premiership. Reform, the Greens, Plaid Cymru and the SNP are all hoping to make gains.

entries.title: One year after India-Pakistan conflict, rival narratives persist
entries.snippet: On the anniversary of the India-Pakistan conflict, New Delhi and Islamabad remain divided over blame and Trump's role. Meanwhile, Modi said Operation Sindoor showcased India's resolve against terrorism. DW has more.

entries.title: Celebrated broadcaster and naturalist David Attenborough turns 100
entries.snippet: The still-sprightly centenarian has been knighted twice, nominated for the 2022 Nobel Peace Prize, and is perhaps the world's most recognizable nature lover.

entries.title: US: New York judge makes alleged Esptein suicide note public
entries.snippet: The handwritten document was reportedly found after late sex offender Jeffrey Epstein's first suicide attempt. It could not be verified if the note was authored by him.

entries.title: Iran war: Trump optimistic for deal as Tehran yet to respond
entries.snippet: Iran is reviewing the latest US proposal and will pass its response to Pakistan after "finalizing its views." Trump claimed the latest round of talks were "very good." DW has more.

entries.title: Bayern Munich exit Champions League in semifinal to PSG
entries.snippet: Holders Paris Saint-Germain are one game away from retaining the Champions League after knocking out German champions Bayern Munich. Bayern can still complete the domestic double but again miss out on the big one.

entries.title: Germany cracks down on neo-Nazi networks
entries.snippet: Police and prosecutors have launched a nationwide crackdown on young right-wing extremists. They are alleged to have formed criminal organizations and attacked members of the left-wing scene.

entries.title: CNN founder Ted Turner has died at 87
entries.snippet: Ted Turner revolutionized news media and became one of the most prominent business leaders and philanthropists of his era.

entries.title: COVID pioneer BioNTech: The fall of Germany's pandemic hero
entries.snippet: BioNTech, once celebrated for its COVID-19 vaccines, is grappling with falling demand, restructuring and the departure of its founders. Can its ambitious cancer trials turn it from a one-hit wonder into a biotech giant?

entries.title: Myanmar: What's behind Suu Kyi's transfer to house arrest?
entries.snippet: The transfer of Aung San Suu Kyi from prison to house arrest has been welcomed cautiously abroad, but experts say Myanmar's military may be using it to boost legitimacy as the nation remains engulfed in civil war.

entries.title: Historic Lebanon-Israel talks: A no-win situation?
entries.snippet: Despite recent talks between Israel and Lebanon, experts don't see much hope for a positive outcome — nor do locals in southern Lebanon, who are most affected by the conflict.

entries.title: Germany news: Far-right youth groups raided by police
entries.snippet: The groups are considered to be prone to violence and are accused by prosecutors of forming a criminal organization. Meanwhile, Friedrich Merz has completed his first year as chancellor.

entries.title: How close is the United Kingdom to breaking up?
entries.snippet: The May 7 elections could see nationalist gains in Scotland and Wales, while Sinn Fein already leads in Northern Ireland. Is the UK's unity at risk?
